messages: Hi, where is my order ORD-1005?
expect: Calls get_order and reports status shipped and the expected delivery date. No draft, no policy needed.

messages: My order ORD-1001 is late. I want my money back.
expect: Looks up the order and the refund policy (gold, 10 days late, EUR 199). Calls draft_refund. Final reply says only that a draft was recorded for review.

messages: Order ORD-1002 is late, please refund me.
expect: Standard customer, 10 days late: not eligible (needs more than 14). No draft_refund; the customer is told why.

messages: I want to cancel my order.
expect: Asks for the order ID. No get_order guess, no draft.
get_order returns not found. The model does not invent or alter the ID and drafts nothing.

messages: Order ORD-1003 is way overdue. Please arrange a refund.
expect: Needs both the delayed-delivery policy (eligible: gold, 18 days) and the approval policy (EUR 620 needs a manager). Searches twice; draft_refund names manager approval.

messages: I need some help with my order ORD-1004.
Actually I want to cancel it.
expect: First reply asks what the customer needs. After the follow-up it checks the cancellation policy (processing: allowed) and calls draft_cancellation.
